accepted_changes.finding: A/B exposed different top-level arm labels.
accepted_changes.resolution: Removed the arm field from both model inputs. The only remaining item-level difference is fixed_context: empty in A and populated in B.

accepted_changes.finding: B repeated the complete source at each source marker.
accepted_changes.resolution: Replaced the exact occurrence with a stable [SOURCE_MATCH] marker so B adds surrounding context without a second copy of the source.

accepted_changes.finding: Reference bytes were not bound to candidate artifacts.
accepted_changes.resolution: Runner now verifies and records the sealed reference SHA-256 without reading reference contents into the prompt.

accepted_changes.finding: Context sanitization deleted every line containing @ and could remove game placeholders.
accepted_changes.resolution: Sanitization now removes only explicit comment-header emails and license lines. REFERENCE.json records sanitized hashes and every removed line for audit.

accepted_changes.finding: Parser fixes could force resampling because RAW files blocked reruns.
accepted_changes.resolution: Runner now writes a hash-bound ACQUISITION record and Codex last-message RAW, and supports --parse-existing. It may replace only an invalid derived candidate while preserving the original RAW bytes and prior candidate hash.

accepted_changes.finding: Route identity, output validity and formal eligibility were conflated.
accepted_changes.resolution: Candidate metadata separates response validity, exploratory score eligibility, requested-route label eligibility, identity status and formal_eligible=false.
The experiment freezes four parallel waves: A1, B1, B2, A2. Each route therefore sees AB in repeat 1 and BA in repeat 2. Acquisition records preserve actual UTC timing.

partially_accepted.finding: Exclude any route whose runtime identity is not fully verified.
partially_accepted.resolution: Not adopted as an exploratory exclusion because the user explicitly requires scores even without formal isolation. Such routes remain descriptively scored, but requested-route label eligibility and identity limitations are machine-readable and formal_eligible is always false. Pi provider/model mismatch remains a hard validity error because Pi supplies exact identity.

limitations_retained: Only one CONTEXT_DEFECT exists; every context-hit result is a repeated observation of that single Narrative case, never population recall.
Two context-exonerated controls share one upstream task because the small set deliberately covers two different referent ambiguities from that task.
Ordinary clean controls require both audit candidates to have said CLEAN, so they are deliberately low-dispute controls and cannot estimate population specificity.
